from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class AssetCategory(BaseModel):
    """Category label defined in the task"""
    value: str = Field(description="Category name")

class CompanyOtherCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """Other Current Assets value from one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as written in the document")
    other_current_assets: float | None = Field(description="Other Current Assets amount in yuan")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="As of date of the balance sheet")
    asset_category: Literal["高额资产", "中额资产", "低额资产", "无资产"] | None = Field(description="Category classification based on task thresholds")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_other_current_assets: list[CompanyOtherCurrentAssets]
